ui_bugs.issue: The overrides use an empty string: closingText passes { ...ev, closing: "" } and cardDua passes { ...e, dua: "" }. But pick() in traditions.js returns the custom value unless it is null or undefined, so "" counts as 'host cleared it' and the defaults are dropped. As a result, multi-event cards show no closing line and no dua anywhere. Fix: use closing: null and dua: null (or call defaultClosing(card) and defaultDua(card, e) directly).

issues: Christian: '...we joyfully invite you to celebrate the wedding celebrations with us.' is redundant ('celebrate ... celebrations').
The cover hub heading is also 'Wedding celebrations', so the same phrase appears twice on the cover (paragraph + heading). Consider 'our wedding' or 'the wedding festivities' in the paragraph.

The blessing is chosen by key and does not follow the tradition. After switching the tradition from Muslim to Hindu or Christian, the blessing stays 'Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Rahim...'. The existing birthday card plan-test shows the blessing 'Two hearts, one journey...' (couple wording on a birthday). Minor, but consider resetting the blessing_key when the tradition or type changes.

action_items: textSlots.js: closingText use { ...ev, closing: null } and cardDua use { ...e, dua: null } (pick() treats "" as an explicit empty value). Then verify: /i/demo-shahnawaz-farah cover has card-event-dua 1 and card-event-closing 1, and e1-e4 have 0 of each.
Optional: reword the multi-event default paragraph so it does not repeat 'celebrations' (Christian) or the hub heading 'Wedding celebrations'.
critical_code_review_comments: pick(custom, fallback) uses '' as the explicit 'cleared' marker. Any code that wants 'use the default' must pass null or undefined, not ''. Consider a helper such as withDefault(card, ev, field) to avoid this mistake again.
invitationParagraph passes wording: '' to defaultWording, which is fine because defaultWording does not use pick. Keep it consistent anyway.

rca of the issue: Repro: open /i/demo-shahnawaz-farah?to=Ali, skip the intro, continue, scroll the cover: there is no card-event-closing and no card-event-dua (also none on e1-e4). Cause: in traditions.js, pick = (custom, fallback) => custom == null ? fallback : custom. textSlots.js passes closing: '' and dua: '' to remove the event-level text, so pick returns '' and the default closing and dua are never used. Mitigation: pass null instead of ''.
